build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a slope, container, ball, table, and strut scene
add_convex_polygon: create a convex polygon body in the PHYRE scene using vertex coordinates
add_container: add a container object to the PHYRE scene with specified vertices and dimensions
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene at a given position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define spatial relationships between bodies like TOUCHING
